'''Sivousplay''' was a building in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. A large [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] marquee stated the name of the establishment.

==Behind the scenes==
Sivousplay is a play on words of the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] phrase ''[[Wikipedia:wikt:s'il vous plaît|s'il vous plaît]]'', meaning "please."
